“As a current National Board Member and proud alum, I am deeply grateful for the opportunities INROADS has provided me, particularly introducing me to Procter & Gamble. INROADS equips students with the skills, resilience, and mindset to thrive in any environment. It’s a key reason why P&G is a supporter, recognizing its transformative impact on individuals and communities.”

“INROADS aligns with Bayer’s vision of developing the top commercial organization in the world. They excel in finding top talent who bring a diverse perspective, align with our core values, and consistently grow into future top leaders.”

“Our purpose at Zoetis is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. This includes creating awareness with future talent about the animal health industry through our partnership with INROADS. Having the opportunity to work with college students through our internship program brings Zoetis the unique perspectives we need and creates important connections that last.”

“At Roche, we believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive our mission to improve lives around the world. Our partnership with INROADS enables us to connect with exceptional early-in-career talent, bringing fresh ideas and innovative leadership to our organization. Together, we’re building a pipeline of future leaders who reflect the communities we serve and share our commitment to advancing healthcare equity and excellence.”

“At MetLife, our interns are a valued part of our workforce and help us solve real-world business problems. Through our long-standing partnership with INROADS, we’ve helped create pathways for nearly 900 students and counting!”

“Boeing is proud to once again partner with INROADS and looks forward to all that we will accomplish together in the future. Our partnership means that more students gain access to business skills development, mentoring, and more to help propel them into successful careers. And some of those students, like me, have found amazing careers at Boeing.”

“At Marathon Petroleum, we’re committed to fostering an innovative, high-performing, and inclusive workplace for the success of individuals, teams, and the company. We strive to create a collaborative and supportive environment where all employees can build on their strengths and maximize their talents and abilities. We’re excited to collaborate with the INROADS team in this work and to create pathways into careers for diverse talents.”

“We are deeply committed to having an impact in the lives of young people of wide-ranging backgrounds seeking to prepare for and build careers in our industry. In doing so, we strive also to position Houlihan Lokey as a positive force for change in the financial services industry.”

“Microsoft thrives and remains relevant when we attract the best and brightest. This is why we partner with INROADS, connecting us with talented individuals from varied backgrounds and life experiences.”
